decomposed_tasks.title: Build Filter Toolbar Component
decomposed_tasks.description: Create a new UI component for the Filter Bar placed above Kanban columns. Must include 'All' button, 'My Tasks' button, and a visual list (avatars or dropdown) of team members.

decomposed_tasks.title: Implement Client-Side Filtering Logic
decomposed_tasks.description: Integrate the Filter Toolbar state (selectedAssigneeId) into the main KanbanBoard component. Filter the local tasks array before distributing them to columns. Ensure empty columns display a 0 count and an empty state message.
